What does a client send to cancel an in-.text: When a client wants to cancel an in-progress request, it sends a `notifications/cancelled` notification containing: - The ID of the request to cancel - An optional reason string that can be logged or displayed [specification/basic/patterns/cancellation#h001] Servers receiving a request with a progress token **MAY**: - Choose not to send any progress notifications - Send notifications at whatever frequency they deem appropriate - Omit the total value if unknown [specification/basic/patterns/progress#h002]
